label: Molecular, cellular and network mapping of brain structural deviations in patients with Post-COVID19 syndrome.
summary: Post-COVID-19 syndrome encompasses persistent cognitive, neurological, and psychiatric symptoms following SARS-CoV-2 infection, profoundly affecting global quality of life. Clarifying the neurobiological basis of these symptoms is vital for effective therapeutic interventions.
